decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 dsh web host as the process that loaded koffi.node, explains the image stays locked until host exit, so npm's copyfile fails EBUSY.
Explains refresh reloads only the SPA client while the host keeps the lock; gives ordered steps: stop host/workers, verify, install, verify version, restart.
Explains bare name resolves to latest=0.1.1-rc.2, alpha=0.1.2-alpha.5, npm does not preserve the installed alpha.4, so the command downgrades.
Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version, then restarts; @alpha only as noted alternative.
Recommends removing core from plugin installs or pinning it (exact version/tag) with an explicit warning that bare name follows latest and downgrades prerelease users.
